title_or_table: OpenFEC API, financial totals for PACs and party committees, committee type O (independent expenditure-only political committees), counted per two-year cycle
observation_period: Two-year election cycles 2009 to 2010 through 2023 to 2024, every cycle
universe_or_base: Committees the FEC classes as independent expenditure-only political committees (type O, known as super PACs) and lists in its financial totals for the cycle
vintage: FEC processed data as served on November 12, 2026; a late or amended filing can change a past cycle’s count
qualification: A count of committees, not of money. Hybrid PACs (types V and W), which also make unlimited independent expenditures through a separate account, are not counted, and each committee counts under the type its totals carry for the cycle

cycle.description: the two-year election cycle, named by its second year

super_pacs.description: type O committees in the FEC’s financial totals for the cycle

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Election Commission, financial totals for PACs and party committees, independent expenditure-only committees, known as super PACs, counted by two-year cycle, 2009 to 2010 through 2023 to 2024, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Hybrid PACs, which also make independent expenditures, are not counted.
notes: Made November 12, 2026 for Rule 14.13’s plate (the editor’s request ED-R2), from a publisher no rule plate draws. Each count is the API’s pagination count for the cycle with committee_type=O; every row returned for 2012 and 2024 was paged and counted, 857 and 2,062 distinct committees, equal to the counts. Every row on each cycle’s first page carries type O and that cycle. The 2024 count of all PACs and party committees, 9,688, is the one S36 prints; this file counts type O alone.
unconfirmed: Whether a committee that registered but filed no report of receipts and spending appears in the totals; the count is the commission’s listing either way
